lesson.title: Correct non-compliance and communicate risk
lesson.summary: Respond immediately to non-conformity and communicate qualifying risks.

prerequisites.reason: The identified risk/non-compliance informs the action.

blocks: **Provider corrective action** begins when a provider considers or has reason to consider its supplied high-risk system is not in conformity. Immediately take necessary action to bring it into conformity, withdraw, disable or recall it as appropriate.
These are different available responses, not a command to recall every issue. Select effective action for the actual non-conformity and circumstances.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Article 20(1), (2); Article 79(1)

blocks: Inform affected distributors and, where applicable, deployers, authorised representative and importers accordingly. A quiet internal ticket does not establish these required communications.
Northbridge discovering that its supplied instructions omit a critical limitation must examine necessary correction and who needs the information. The action and communication should match the issue.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Article 20(1), (2); Article 79(1)

blocks: **Provider risk information** is additional where the system presents Article 79 risk and the provider becomes aware. Immediately investigate causes, collaborating with the reporting deployer where applicable.

Inform competent market-surveillance authorities and, where applicable, the notified body that issued the certificate, particularly about non-conformity and relevant corrective action. Market-surveillance authorities oversee compliance in the relevant jurisdiction.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Article 20(1), (2); Article 79(1)

blocks: Case: an employer reports harmful ranking behaviour and the provider has evidence of a qualifying risk. Waiting for the next quarterly meeting does not fit the immediate investigation/information duties.

Record the finding, necessary action and communication. Specific Article 73 incident definitions and reporting deadlines require the later operations analysis; do not invent one universal deadline for every problem.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Article 20(1), (2); Article 79(1)
